# Fixed retained managed connector workflow

Manual dispatch only, read-only repository and package permissions, separate
orchestration and pinned cc1 owner checkouts without persisted credentials.
Preflight runs before login and acquisition. The product-owned helper invokes
the existing historical controller/candidate modes. Only its bounded result JSON
is retained, for 30 days, including failure/incomplete evidence. No historical
release evidence is rewritten. A new execution release is required for dispatch.
